decisions.decision: The sections are peers in one column rather than nested.
decisions.why: Switching one off removes a row instead of leaving a hole, and moving one changes only its position.

decisions.decision: AcademyChrome owns palette and template reading.
decisions.why: A hook every block could call would spread one decision everywhere and leave nowhere to prove theming works.

decisions.decision: StudentEntryPanel is a new block, not a mode flag on the control plane's SignInPanel.
decisions.why: SignInPanel is weighted for someone who already has an account; a student's entry leads with registration, which is a different product sentence.

decisions.decision: Apply adds next-intl to apps/expert and moves product strings into catalogues.
decisions.why: The user's instruction is English throughout and multilingual the way starci is; the scaffold has no i18n layer at all.

decisions.decision: Academy-owned text stays out of the catalogues.
decisions.why: An academy's name and section text are one academy's data, not product copy; translating them would be a category error.

rejectedDirections.title: proof before offer
rejectedDirections.why: It leads with the rung both reference academies lean on hardest, but its three leading sections are all empty on an academy's first day, which is every academy's first day.

rejectedDirections.title: one question at a time
rejectedDirections.why: Shortest path to a lead, but its email-first entry needs the backend to answer whether an address has an account, and the password-reset e2e proves the product deliberately refuses to disclose exactly that.
